title: Hand drawn graphics
slide_intent: Show how an informal mark can direct attention to a headline or photographic detail. A hand-drawn gesture needs a clear target to serve that purpose.
strategic_value: The organization can give communications a sense of human energy while keeping the central message and photograph legible.
demonstration: Large doodled rings, arrows and short strokes surround two completed examples, including a publication cover and a social post.
practical_value: Place one hand-drawn accent where it points to information that deserves a second look, then check that it remains secondary to the message.

content_islands.name: Gesture guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the left column to explain the vocabulary and identify the accents as supporting elements.

content_islands.name: Marks and applications
content_islands.spec: Scatter enlarged strokes over the pale field and overlap the examples near the center. Repeat a mark at smaller scale inside the finished design so the reader sees its job.
